silhouette_iou.definition: Undilated source and fixed-cast output masks, intersected with observed crop support. Missing output detection yields observed=null and explicit empty-prediction IoU0. Technical SAM failure has no metric.

outside_mask_preservation.caveat: Original canonical RGB comparison after inverse bilinear resize; crop support excluded. M3 frame0 mask is zero, so its approved anchor difference is included. Baseline/canny use M1 evaluation ROI only.

caveats: SAM correspondence and opposite nearest assignment are geometric proxies, not proof of visual identity.
Reflection bbox rule may associate one reflection with multiple bodies; color differences are reference-only.
SAM max4 tracking can omit instances; masks and inverse resizing affect descriptive metrics.
